metadata.title: cEPRSDBFeatures
metadata.description: cEPRSDBfeatures Module helps in managing the DBFeatures like cEPRSKillDBSessions - Resource helps in Stopping the DB processes, cEPRSRestoreDBFromBackup - Resource helps in restoring the DB from Backup, cEPRSRestoreSnapshot - Resource helps in restoring the DBSnapshot, cEPRSExecuteSql - Resource helps in executing the sql files, and cEPRSDBSnapShot - Resource helps in generating the DBSnapshot

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Restore-SQLdatabase' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.description: Parameter '$SQLPassword' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
